title: Citrix security advisory (AV26-996)
description: As of October 4, 2026, Citrix is affected by a vulnerability in the following products:
products:
NetScaler ADC
	Prior to 13.1-37.282
Prior to 13.1-64.28
Prior to 14.1-73.41
Prior to 14.1-73.41 FIPS

NetScaler Gateway
	Prior to 13.1-64.28
Prior to 14.1-73.41
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
